discovery: Initialize, tools/list, resources/list and capabilities inspection are windowless. The first valid workspace request attaches or launches the opted-in GUI. Embedded command metadata is generated from the live registry and parity-tested. Camera arrays have exactly three numeric elements; export array items require kind/index identities. Recursive item validation rejects invalid_argument before handlers or workspace connection. Pickup source identities have four required typed fields; destination maps have string values; integers advertise handler-compatible bounds.
inspection: List queries filter case-insensitively before pagination and retain record identities. Preview state describes the active viewer; unavailable 3D options are null. Invalid workspace tab requests leave presentation preferences unchanged. Missing structural edit targets return stale_record. Preview capture requires the preview lifetime UUID and returns preview/asset identity; window captures are independent. 3D capture preserves aspect ratio. Explicit camera poses are clamped upright before subsequent movement. Isolation/Show all reject animation previews, matching GUI availability; static pickup isolation uses the complete pickup root. Scene selection and camera mutations preserve active GUI pickup drags by returning busy. Accepted application closing cancels retained preview/editor lifetimes before draining MCP; canceled closing preserves them, and MCP-only disable still permits recovery. Concurrent teardown is shared and cannot reopen access during shutdown. MCP shutdown cancels pending jobs and audio retries without owning retained preview lifetimes; canceled animation level refreshes release their loading overlay. Static LOD/horizon/texture-pack and Whole world difficulty refreshes retain the published scene and options until successful replacement; cancellation restores the saved difficulty. Canceled asset/document loading retries the still-current GUI selection outside the operation scope; navigation/disposal/shutdown suppress obsolete recovery. Superseded MCP scene refreshes report context_changed; failed preparation reports preview_unavailable, with no unpublished preview result. Properties opening verifies publication/identity, links request cancellation, and rechecks pending drafts after decoding. Decoder traversal observes cancellation. Inspection freezes one edited revision and links request/document cancellation, preserving separate original data; disposed or revised results are rejected. Reload stages parsing and guards drafts/revisions/navigation before atomic document replacement, retaining the old document/preview on staging failure. Root/file navigation guards asynchronous publication, including newer pending file loads. GUI browsing keeps pinned Properties drafts. Saves/modal dialogs exclude MCP mutations; read-only state remains available. Approved preview setting drafts apply as one frozen batch and preserve newer input. Late pickup sessions and export/validation reports cannot publish after document closure. Animation binds and late renderer refreshes recover only for originating MCP cancellation; same-editor GUI seek supersession reports context_changed. LOD waits cancel before mutation; pending picker choices cannot leak into another seek. Initial binding and Map/Horizon refreshes reconcile the latest presentation choices and retain playback or explicit Pause. Static refresh ownership survives reentrant status callbacks. Deferred window close preserves new edits/drafts/drag without prompting. Malformed keyframe payloads retain available property fields and a read-only diagnostic at segment 0.

interactions.note: Dynamically created View/3D Navigation items share named views, projection and framing with camera. Follow uses animation_options.followCamera. Projection check states read the live camera.
Numpad views/orbit/pan/zoom/projection/framing and Home use shared semantic operations. Native text, timeline and menu keys remain native; Numpad 0 shares Follow camera.

Middle orbit, Shift-middle screen pan, Ctrl-middle centered zoom and Ctrl-Shift-middle dolly use camera rotate/pan/zoom/dolly. Camera reads expose projection and exact axis state; automation never captures physical input. Camera-dependent horizons and animation effects refresh after inertial motion at the frame boundary.
View-cube faces use camera view; edges/corners use perspective camera set. The cube uses +Y up and -Z front, matching keyboard/menu axis views.

Dynamic Edit/Archive members and Assets context menus share the resource session. Member UUIDs survive rename, reorder and undo; imported known payloads are validated off-thread. Aliased payload ranges share immutable decoding but retain independent member edits. Malformed embedded ZRD remains raw with a warning and supports member repair. Raw export uses the edited snapshot.

Typed Data tree and dynamic context/Edit menus use ordered node UUIDs. Standalone ZRD requires complete bounded decoding before edit/save controls are enabled. Complete structural decoding retains ZRD editing after member rename/save/reopen, without relying on extensions. Add/type/duplicate/delete/move use shared validation and one undo step; type replaces existing children even when choosing Array again, while set accepts scalars. Selection keeps Properties pinned. GUI labels and zrd_nodes bound string prefixes before JSON escaping; MCP marks valueTruncated at 4096 characters. Paging retains only the returned page; ZRD filtering runs off-thread with cancellation/revision checks.

Generated member/node fields share asynchronous validation, retained invalid drafts, document revision checks, undo and verified saves. Values over 16384 displayed characters expose a read-only prefix, never an editable truncated draft. ZRD JSON inspection bounds tree/string expansion and marks truncation; full exports remain available. Retarget and close resolve drafts. Save As requires a new destination and retargets later saves and reload; an already-open destination blocks reload.

Edit and Assets context menus share PNG import, explicit sibling targets, record-index disambiguation, one batch undo, ownership, mirrored open views and verified per-file save results. Current Save As aliases are excluded from variant discovery and explicit imports. Partial Save As retains all requested destinations, keeps unpublished copies dirty and retries them as new files without falling back to source paths. This pack is the default; variant dimensions and storage class are retained.

Dynamic script menus and virtualized instruction rows share stable script/instruction identities, structural actions and explicit pinned Properties targeting. Read-only reconstructed Text and original Bytes remain separate. Malformed records retain scoped errors and leave valid scripts inspectable/exportable at their authored indices, while the whole pack stays ineligible for editing/saving. Selection never executes commands or retargets Properties.

Generated timestamp/name/token fields and asynchronous argument actions use shared draft validation, revisions, stable identities and undo. Literal Latin-1 tokens use JSON quotes. Oversized values are read-only prefixes; complete instruction replacement remains available. Save As retargets later saves and reload.

AI marker picking and its dynamic Properties context action share snapshot identities with AI discovery and selection. Hover/selection labels derive from the same node data. Malformed node value types are diagnosed individually while valid neighbors remain visible; malformed duplicate indices remain ambiguous. Frame selected uses camera; normal scene framing excludes the overlay.

Whole world exclusive solid highlights: changes.highlight accepts none, nonDefaultSoils (yellow), canModify (green), or clipTo (red). preview_state reports highlight, null outside Whole world. Uses the GUI setter without replacing the preview, changing source data, or enabling local MCP. Entire option batches are validated first; requested highlights wait for successful refreshes and never overwrite newer GUI choices.

Validate explicit source-fingerprinted OBJ/PNG mappings as one shared document undo step, with native model and texture save support. Shared ownership claims all prepared source/current/destination paths before acceptance or save. Conflicts preserve revision/history, claims survive undo/save until close, and oversized model/texture outputs fail before allocation. Assets, Document scene and pinned asset Properties refresh accepted records by identity; Undo/Redo removes/restores appended records without retargeting Properties.
Whole world AI visibility, network filter and through-geometry drawing share scene options and preview state. AI controls form one native overflow group and coexist with surface highlights.
